name: kaleidoscope-bench-vision-subset
description: A vision-focused subset of the Kaleidoscope benchmark designed to evaluate image understanding and robustness across diverse visual scenarios and attributes. It measures model performance on image classification and visual reasoning tasks drawn from varied conditions intended to stress generalization. Used to compare vision and multimodal models on robustness, attribute recognition, and VQA-style queries.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used for vision robustness evaluations; modest but growing usage in the research community.
